Old worker cannot republish pre-restore tree/cache; a requested replacement starts only after it returns
Hidden models do not automatically launch replacement scans; leaving again clears pending request
Old last-opened metadata result is dropped after restore generation changes
limits: No new visible restore-to-space GUI acceptance
CLI uses real restore code but an owned temporary fake Trash, not user native Trash
Cross-process scan/restore cache ordering is not globally serialized
Last-opened metadata worker physical concurrency remains outside this change
Filesystem calls may delay cancellation; no force-quit/crash durability acceptance
Selection size provenance remains to audit
No user files moved, root query, helper install, hardware writes or release
